description: Defines the NotAllowedException class in the SuiteCRM exception hierarchy, extending the base Exception class and adding a custom constructor with a default error code.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\NotAllowedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an operation is not allowed, extends general Exception class and prepends a specific message prefix.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NotAllowedException with a message and code, defaulting to an 'API_CONTENT_NEGOTIATION_FAILED' error code and prepending '[Not Allowed]' to the message.
